youtube.title: He Traded A Paperclip For A House (True Story) 📎🏠
youtube.description:
In July 2005, Kyle MacDonald, a Canadian blogger, posted one red paperclip online and offered to trade it for something bigger. His plan: keep trading up until he owned a house.

The same day it became a pen shaped like a fish, then a doorknob with a face. Then a camping stove, a generator, a snowmobile, a trip, a box truck, a recording contract and a year's free rent in Phoenix. He traded the rent for an afternoon with rock star Alice Cooper, then swapped that for a KISS snow globe, and people online called it the dumbest decision ever.

But actor Corbin Bernsen collects snow globes (thousands of them) and wanted that one, so he offered a part in his movie. The town of Kipling, Saskatchewan held auditions for the part and paid for it with a two-storey house. One year, fourteen trades.

What would YOU have traded the paperclip for? 👇

A true story, animated Roblox-style. Follow viralrobloxgames for more stories like this.
